policy: Every `ready` user-facing example matches a checked-in ManimCE v0.21.0 upstream source fixture byte-for-byte after replacing exactly `from manim import *` with `from noon import *`. Exact-source examples may be `candidate` before a dedicated raster/timeline fixture exists; `parity-qualified` additionally requires the canonical exact-output gates. Noon-specific parity probes remain in the parity corpus and are never substituted for upstream public examples.

parity_policy.candidate: The literal upstream ManimCE v0.21.0 source executes in Noon, with only the import changed. Dedicated exact-output qualification may still be open.
parity_policy.parity-qualified: The literal upstream source (import-only change) also passes the canonical semantic, pixel, timing, lifecycle, intermediate-frame, seek/playback, and supported-backend gates defined by #185/#176.
